messages.subject: simulate_source_areas_ana_clado error
parts:
Dear all,

When I run the lines in the "Time-stratified example script for Biogeographical Stochastic Mapping (BSM)" I get the next error:

#############################
> BSMs_w_sourceAreas = simulate_source_areas_ana_clado(res, clado_events_tables, ana_events_tables, areanames)
Read 9 items
Read 280 items
Read 9 items
Read 280 items
Read 9 items
Read 280 items


Simulating the ancestral areas for cases where the ancestral area occupied 2 or more areas (number of stochastic maps=50):
1 Error in sample.int(length(x), size, replace, prob) :
  NA in probability vector
###############################################

Thanks for any thought.

Cheers,

Marcial.

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] simulate_source_areas_ana_clado error
parts:
Hi,

This is a new error as far as I remember. It might occur if your areanames in your geography file are not single-letter:

Good area names for BSM: A, B, C

Bad area names for BSM: Afr, Eur, Aus

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeographical-stochastic-mapping-example-script#BSMsingle_letter

If that doesn't fix it, please email me all the input files and script and I will debug. 

Cheers!
Nick
